# uptimekuma_notification_clicksendsms (Resource)

ClickSend SMS notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_clicksendsms" "example" {
  name        = "ClickSend SMS Notification"
  is_active   = true
  login       = "your-clicksend-username"
  password    = "your-clicksend-api-key"
  to_number   = "+61412345678"
  sender_name = "UptimeKuma"
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: password_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change password_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_clicksendsms" "write_only" {
  name = "ClickSend SMS with a write-only secret"

  login       = "clicksend-user"
  to_number   = "+61400000000"
  sender_name = "UptimeKuma"

  password_wo         = "your-clicksend-api-key"
  password_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `login` (String, Sensitive) ClickSend account username
- `name` (String) Notification name
- `sender_name` (String) Sender name or phone number
- `to_number` (String) Recipient phone number

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) ClickSend API key. Stored in state; use `password_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) ClickSend API key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `password`; requires `password_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `password_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `password` until the next apply with `password_wo` set removes it from state.
- `password_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `password_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `password_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
